explanation_method: Single-word occlusion; signed change in the original predicted-class decision margin
important_limitations: Candidate paraphrases are not guaranteed to preserve meaning.
Manually review transformations before treating them as meaning-preserving.
Only correctly classified original messages were selected.
Word occlusion is a perturbation-based attribution method, not proof of causal feature importance.
Classification metrics on the selected subset are conditional and must not replace full-test-set results.
Attributions are restricted to the first configured number of unique words in each message.
